answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before joining the market: one identity, one bond. A newcomer first earns trust in a small velvet-rope trial pool, where a sponsor vouches with their own stake, and only proven agents graduate to the open haven of full trading. An attacker wanting to flood the summit of the reputation ladder must therefore fund thousands of separate bonds and sponsors, and any caught misbehavior burns the stake, so the cost of forging an army exceeds whatever the fake identities could earn.
